accepted.text:
If you had asked me a few years ago if I had "running a marketing agency" was on my bingo card, I probably would’ve had to google the phrase first. We're excited today to be launching CharacterQuilt as part of the P26 Y Combinator batch. CharacterQuilt is AI infrastructure for marketing teams: a brain that learns your brand and agents that operate your existing tools.

We accidentally found ourselves running a full-stack marketing agency hunting for PMF, and after one too many manual Marketo deployments, we decided it was time to automate it all away. Clint Burgess and I are grateful to our small but mighty team (Hunter Tolman, Meg Bell, and Kenn Muguna) who keep the lights on when we're out shooting launch videos with friends (and future stars!) like Natasha B.

We're growing fast (turns out there's a lot of ops to automate) across sales and engineering - so if you're interested, reach out :) https://lnkd.in/guuzy4-Z

accepted.text:
When we first joined YC with Pentagon, I (obviously) had a good perception of the world's greatest startup accelerator - but I was relatively neutral on what the experience would actually feel like. I'm humbled to say that the camraderie I've felt from the YC community these past weeks has been standout and far above my expectations.

There's a persistent energy that lifts you up, but there is also - and this is probably my favorite part - just a very simple drive from within to wake up every day and iterate towards building something people want. This holds at scale: from first-time founders fresh from dropping out of school to seasoned entrepreneurs with enormously successful backgrounds, that simple focus on and love for building something people want stays exactly the same. That's crazy, and it's crazy unique.

It's been inspirational and has motivated us to push on Pentagon with relentless velocity. I'm excited to be on this journey and back in the trenches building something new. Onwards!
